initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table and arithmetic checks do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R217-2 to assess whether the standardized difference identifies the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing stratum risk differences over the population distribution of Z identifies the causal effect: 0.4(0.4−0.5) + 0.6(0.9−0.6) = 0.14.
